evidence.observation: TotalEnergies' public Morocco charging-network table lists AL WAHA with 1 charger at 22 AC.
The directory currently lists TotalEnergies El Waha at 50 kW without a named operator, while separately identifying some other TotalEnergies sites such as Amskroud and Taourirt as Kilowatt-operated.
supports: Kilowatt operates at least some TotalEnergies-branded Morocco charging sites
conflicts_with_official_source: Al Waha power: third party 50 kW vs official TotalEnergies 22 kW AC

modeling_decision.reason: Do not infer CPO from site brand or from Kilowatt attribution at other TotalEnergies locations. No sufficiently strong public evidence currently attributes AL WAHA itself to Kilowatt.
modeling_decision.power_precedence: Use official TotalEnergies 22 kW AC over conflicting third-party 50 kW directory data.
modeling_decision.production_policy: Keep CPO/operator unresolved until a Kilowatt-native, TotalEnergies-native, OCPI/eMSP, charger label, or other direct station-specific source links AL WAHA to Kilowatt.

blocker.missing_evidence: station-specific CPO attribution for AL WAHA
next_validating_evidence_examples: Kilowatt app/backend station record naming AL WAHA
TotalEnergies station/app record naming Kilowatt as operator
public OCPI/eMSP record with station-specific operator identity
